verdict.rationale: OpenTofu's own docs cover the core of drift detection. `tofu plan` previews the changes needed to reconcile configuration with real infrastructure, and refresh-only mode builds a plan specifically to match changes made to remote objects outside of OpenTofu. Missing for 10: any documented continuous or scheduled drift monitoring and alerting, detailed docs on drift reporting (e.g. exit codes for CI detection), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
